title: silene parnassica subsp. hayekiana
intro: Silene parnassica subsp. hayekiana, commonly known as Balkan catchfly, is a plant species belonging to the family Caryophyllaceae. It is valued for its medicinal properties and used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Balkan catchfly include its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antioxidant properties, which can help soothe wounds, reduce pain, and protect against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects.
